capability: Each helper sees only what its job needs
title: Hand over only the right cards.

hook.picture: Close on the whale tipping a whole drawer of grey cards onto a pod; one small card with a faint mark slides to the very bottom of the heap.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: I gave it the whole folder. It missed the one rule.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: marketing manager briefing an AI helper

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: the heap is huge. Three more drawers tip in, every 2 beats, then 1, then half; each time the small card sinks deeper and the pod's cross count climbs.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: The rule drowns under everything else.

stakes.body: The one rule that mattered is broken in public, and the fix is to read everything yourself next time.

solution_hint: Give it only what this job needs.

metaphor.body: Cards hang from the line in tiers, from rules for everyone down to this one job; a helper standing at its job sees its own tier and the tiers above, never a neighbour's.

steps.picture: The heap lifts into three tiers hanging from the line: a top tier for everyone, a team tier, a job tier. The small rule card rises to the top tier.
steps.sound: Three tuned chimes, high to low

steps.picture: The pod swims to the job tier; only its tier and the tiers above light up, the rest dim.
steps.words: Only this job, plus the rules above.
steps.sound: The chime that matches its tier

steps.picture: The pod's stack is short; the rule card sits on top of it.
Push-in: a card from a neighbouring team's tier drifts toward the pod and is refused at the joint between tiers, a raw sienna cross, a small drop.
A second pod at a different job swims in and gets a different short stack, same top tier.
Both pods hold their short stacks; the tiers glow faintly.
steps.words: Where a card applies is its scope.

real_case.claim: Context Atoms: an agent at a scope sees that scope and everything above it; the first three jobs share a spine of 9 atoms, to be verified first.

honest_limit.picture: A card with a dashed outline (still a draft, never agreed) sits in the job tier, lights up like the others and lands in the pod's short stack.
honest_limit.words: Unchecked notes get through just as easily.

not_this.body: Short is not the same as checked.

ending_pattern.body: FELT framing: the whale and the same pod. Instead of a drawer, a short stack slides over with the small rule card on top; the pod answers, nothing is circled, its chip shows a tick.
ending_pattern.callback: The rule card that sank to the bottom in bar 1 now arrives first, in the same close framing.

end_belief.body: Give each helper only what its job needs.
